mainEntity.name: How much does fence stability restoration cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of fence stability restoration varies depending on the extent of the damage, the type of fence material, and the number of posts or sections needing repair. Minor repairs, such as reinforcing a few wobbly posts, will be less expensive than extensive work like replacing multiple rotted posts and fence panels. We provide a detailed estimate after a site inspection.
